- Section B (Personnel) — mina_haddad (People Ops) — deliverables: background checks policy, role matrix — ETA: 5 business days
- Section C (Data Security) — aditya_rao (Infra/SRE) — deliverables: network diagrams, encryption-at-rest docs — ETA: 4 business days
- Section D (Change Management) — laura_bennett (Platform PM) — deliverables: change policy, deployment logs sample — ETA: 5 business days
- Section E (Vendor Management / Subprocessors) — jonas_weber (Security Partnerships) — deliverables: subprocessors list, contracts summary — ETA: 4 business days

Action items: please confirm owners or propose alternates, and indicate which artifacts you can drop into the Acme drive (link below) immediately. We'll track progress in JIRA SUP-1143 and update Acme with a single consolidated delivery.
